dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge is linear with no discernible curvature, representing a single geometric segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute angular vertex with no measurable rounding radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow angular ascent from the anterior dorsal ridge at approximately 28 degrees.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Elongated base relative to height, ratio approximately 1.7:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, large-radius arc defining the anterior-dorsal melon boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick aspect ratio; protruding length is roughly 50% of the cranial height.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon geometric rendering artifacts and a uniform cyan-teal color profile.
